title: The Apology (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan male vocal absurdist observational warm late night
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, soft and careful]
I want to tell you about a man
Who said the wrong thing at a dinner party
On a Friday evening in November
It was not a large thing, but it was a thing

[Verse 1]
He drove home replaying the moment
About twelve and a half times
By the time he reached his driveway
He had identified fourteen improvements

He practised the apology on Saturday morning
Before his wife was awake
He adjusted the opening sentence four times
And the closing sentence twice

He refined it on Sunday
He took the pause out and put it back
He moved the acknowledgement from verse one to verse two
And tested several transitions

[Pre-Chorus]
By the third week he had something
That was precise, warm, proportional, and true
He called the number, she answered
He said I've been meaning to say to you

[Chorus]
She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten
I had completely forgotten about that
She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten
I honestly hadn't thought of it since
He stood in the hallway
For quite a long moment
She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten
He said yes, he said yes, he said yes

[Verse 2]
He thanked her and put the phone down quietly
He thought about the fourteen improvements
He thought about the pause he'd taken out and put back
He thought about the three weeks

[Bridge - spoken, very level]
The apology was excellent
He's kept it
He's not sure what for
He filed it under A

[Chorus]
She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten
I had completely forgotten about that
She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten
I honestly hadn't thought of it since
He stood in the hallway
For quite a long moment
She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten
He said yes, he said yes, he said yes

[Outro - piano, one note at a time]
He went to another dinner party in March
He was very careful
He said nothing remarkable
It was a very successful evening
